scenarios.context: Two new students meet on their first day.

speakerA.en: I'm so glad we're in the same class. I hardly know anyone here.
I think we'll hit it off. We both love football and pizza.
No, but I hear he has a heart of gold.
Great. Then let's sit with him at lunch.

speakerB.en: We're in the same boat, then. I'm new, too.
Ha! That's a good start. Have you met Kian? He's the class clown.
True. He's always the first to help anybody.
Good idea. I think we'll all get along like a house on fire.

scenarios.context: A student is very happy about joining a team.

speakerA.en: You're smiling from ear to ear. What's the good news?
Congratulations! You worked hard for it.
I remember. I told you to keep your chin up.
That's what friends are for. Let's celebrate with a pizza.

speakerB.en: I'm on cloud nine! I got into the school football team.
Thanks. Last week I was down in the dumps because I thought I had no chance.
You did, and you were right. Thanks for believing in me.
Great idea. My treat this time.

scenarios.context: Two friends talk before a school performance.

speakerA.en: Tomorrow I have to sing in front of the whole school, and I'm getting cold feet.
I'm afraid I'll forget the words. I just want to run away.
I know, but it's easier said than done. My hands are shaking.
Okay. And you'll be in the audience, right?

speakerB.en: That's normal. Everyone feels nervous before something big.
Remember: practice makes perfect. You've sung that song a hundred times.
Take it one step at a time. First smile, then start the song.
Of course! I'll be in the front row, and I'll cheer the loudest.

scenarios.context: A boy asks his friend why a classmate is upset with him.

speakerA.en: Why is Lara giving me the cold shoulder? She didn't say hello today.
Oh no! I didn't mean to hurt her. I had a lot on my mind.
I feel terrible. What should I do?
You're right. I'll tell her the truth and say I'm sorry.

speakerB.en: She's upset. You forgot her birthday last week.
I know. But it was the last straw because you also cancelled your plans twice.
Apologise face to face and bring a small gift. Don't beat around the bush.
Good. I'm sure you two will patch things up soon.

scenarios.context: A girl is worried about her sick dog.

speakerA.en: You've been quiet all day. Is everything okay?
I'm so sorry. If you need a shoulder to cry on, I'm here.
The vet is good. Maybe he'll be better in no time.
I know. Would you like me to come with you to the vet?

speakerB.en: Not really. My dog is sick, and I'm very worried.
Thanks. I'm trying to look on the bright side, but it's hard.
I hope so. He's like a member of the family.
Yes, please. A friend in need is a friend indeed.
